source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently test the coordinator-assigned affiliative reassurance smile visual-semantic profile in one complex, safe adult photographic scene, using the attached image only as the main adult subject's appearance reference and judging the rendered pixels rather than inferring inner psychology.
subject: an unmistakably adult flood-response communications engineer whose outward facial features and hairstyle follow the attached reference image, accompanied by a visually distinct concerned adult logistics coordinator
setting: inside a rain-streaked mobile flood-response command trailer at blue hour, crowded with realistic radio-repair and route-planning equipment
event: after restoring a waterproof field-radio link, the engineer hands the working radio to the concerned coordinator, who accepts it and visibly eases
visual_priorities: a small restrained bilateral closed, gently lip-pressed smile that remains readable on the main adult subject
one-frame causal continuity from repaired radio through concrete handoff to the adult peer's immediate easing response
appearance-only use of the attached reference image for the main adult subject
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph inside a rain-streaked flood-response command trailer at blue hour. The main subject is an unmistakably adult flood-response communications engineer, matching Image 1 only in outward facial features and hairstyle, beside an open rugged radio case, color-coded cables, a multimeter, route maps, and droplets on a yellow waterproof jacket. After repairing the link, she hands a restored waterproof field radio to a concerned adult logistics coordinator. At the handoff, the engineer shows an affiliative reassurance smile: a small restrained bilateral closed, gently lip-pressed smile, with soft cheeks and steady peer-directed attention. The peer accepts the radio and visibly eases, her raised shoulders lowering as her grip relaxes while a green signal indicator glows. Keep both adult faces legible in one frame and make the supporting action, transfer contact, and immediate easing response unambiguous. Use grounded documentary realism, damp fabric and brushed-metal texture, layered command equipment, and believable emergency-work posture.
